about: SHIP PASS (FLY_SHIP_PASS.md 3.5, 12.3): gates known red at the start of the pass. scripts/ship-pass-gates.mjs prints a failing gate listed here as KNOWN-RED (separately from FAIL), and a listed gate that passes as KNOWN-RED (now passing) so its row can be retired. A stream that fixes a red removes its row in the same commit.
